name: Itsukage Honoka
source:
"After all, it's because I'm a genius and a lovable character!"

Likes: Cool things

A member of the "Childhood Friend Corps" as well as the science club. She is a genius first-year student who is famous for being the smartest person in the school. She has a slight [i]chuunibyou[/i] habit, and acting frivolously in order to look cool, in spite of this, she is emotionally sensitive, but as soon as she retorts, she goes back to being a lovable character.

Having an insatiable curiosity, she often secludes herself in the science room, experimenting. Always in pursue of knowledge, she keeps reading books at the library.

Even with G-cup bountiful breasts on her small body, in addition to erotic inverted nipples, she still seems to have some concerns about it.
